Class Width

java.lang.Object
dev.tamboui.style.Width
public final class Width extends Object
Represents the width of an element.

Supports the following values:

  • fill - element fills the available container width
  • fit - element width fits its content
  • Percentage values like 50% or 0.5
  • Fixed character counts like 20
